title: German Apple Strudel
description: A classic German dessert featuring layers of flaky pastry, tender apples, and a hint of cinnamon.
instructions: Roll out pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, combine sliced apples, sugar, and cinnamon. Mix until apples are evenly coated.
Place one half of the pastry on a baking sheet, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Arrange apple mixture on top of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Roll out remaining pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch. Place on top of apple mixture and press edges to seal.
Brush top of pastry with oil and kissed kissed.
Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until pastry is golden brown.
Let cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
